panels.description: Share of prompts that launched at least one subagent (an Agent or Task tool call).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.subagent_count > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.description: Median prompt duration: half of prompts finished faster than this. Duration runs from the prompt to its last recorded event; prompts that made no API request, such as local slash commands, are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
-- Only prompts that made a model request, as on Prompt Duration (p50 / p90).
WITH d AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.started_at, p.ended_at) / 1000000 AS secs
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
    AND p.ended_at IS NOT NULL
), r AS (
  SELECT secs, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY secs) AS pr FROM d
)
SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN secs END) AS "Median"
FROM r

panels.description: The model called by the most prompts. A prompt that called several models counts once for each; prompts that called no model are left out.

targets.rawSql:
-- models_used lists every model a prompt called, comma-separated; JSON_TABLE splits it so each
-- model is counted once per prompt that used it, alone or with others.
WITH prompts AS (
  SELECT p.models_used
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
), models AS (
  SELECT TRIM(j.model) AS model, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM prompts
  JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('["', REPLACE(prompts.models_used, ',', '","'), '"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (model VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) j
  GROUP BY TRIM(j.model)
)
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable ') AS "Most used model"
FROM models m
ORDER BY m.prompts DESC, m.model
LIMIT 1

panels.description: Prompts split into those that launched at least one subagent and those that did not. Per group: prompt count, share of all prompts, average cost per prompt (USD), and average API requests and tool calls per prompt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.api_request_count) AS "API requests per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

panels.description: Median (p50) and 90th percentile prompt duration per day, by the day the prompt started. Duration runs from the prompt to its last recorded event; prompts that made no API request, such as local slash commands, are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH durations AS (
  SELECT DATE(p.started_at) AS day,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.started_at, p.ended_at) / 1000000 AS secs
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT day, secs, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY day, secs IS NULL ORDER BY secs) AS pr
  FROM durations
)
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN secs END) AS "p50",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.9 THEN secs END) AS "p90"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Prompts grouped by how many API requests (model calls) they made, including calls by their subagents and background calls such as session titles. 0 means the prompt never reached the model, as with /exit or other local slash commands.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.label AS "API requests per prompt",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.api_request_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Prompts"
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '0' AS label, 0 AS lo, 0 AS hi
  UNION ALL SELECT 1, '1', 1, 1
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2-3', 2, 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, '4-7', 4, 7
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, '8-15', 8, 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, '16-31', 16, 31
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, '32+', 32, 1000000000
) AS b
CROSS JOIN ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY b.ord, b.label
ORDER BY b.ord

panels.description: One row per model, or combination of models, used by prompts: prompt count, median and p90 duration, average API requests and tool calls per prompt, and average cost per prompt (USD). Prompts that called no model are left out.

targets.rawSql:
-- base is every prompt the panel counts; secs is its duration, kept only for prompts that made a
-- model request, as on Prompt Duration (p50 / p90).
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.models_used AS grp, p.api_request_count, p.tool_call_count, p.subagent_count, p.estimated_cost_usd,
    CASE WHEN p.api_request_count > 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.started_at, p.ended_at) / 1000000 END AS secs
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.models_used <> ''
), ranked AS (
  SELECT grp, secs, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY grp, secs IS NULL ORDER BY secs) AS pr
  FROM base
), durations AS (
  SELECT grp, MIN(CASE WHEN secs IS NOT NULL AND pr >= 0.5 THEN secs END) AS p50,
    MIN(CASE WHEN secs IS NOT NULL AND pr >= 0.9 THEN secs END) AS p90
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY grp
)
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(b.grp, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') AS "Model",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts",
  MAX(d.p50) AS "Median duration",
  MAX(d.p90) AS "p90 duration",
  AVG(b.api_request_count) AS "API requests per prompt",
  AVG(b.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt",
  SUM(b.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt"
FROM base b
JOIN durations d ON d.grp = b.grp
GROUP BY b.grp
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1

panels.description: Daily rates, by the day the prompt started. API error rate = API errors / (API requests + API errors); tool failure rate = failed tool calls / tool calls; tool rejection rate = rejected tool uses / (tool calls + rejected tool uses). Click a point to open Tool & Prompt Failures in a new tab with the same time range and filters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.api_error_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.api_request_count + p.api_error_count), 0) AS "API error rate",
  SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0) AS "Tool failure rate",
  SUM(p.tool_reject_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count + p.tool_reject_count), 0) AS "Tool rejection rate"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;

SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
